title: Huber-based Robust System Identification with Near-Optimal Guarantees Across Independent and Adversarial Regimes
summary: Dynamical systems can confront one of two extreme types of disturbances: persistent zero-mean independent noise, and sparse nonzero-mean adversarial attacks, depending on the specific scenario being modeled. While mean-based estimators like least-squares are well-suited for the former, a median-based approach such as the $\ell_1$-norm estimator is required for the latter. In this paper, we propose a Huber-based estimator, characterized by a threshold constant $μ$, to identify the governing matrix of a linearly parameterized nonlinear system from a single trajectory of length $T$.
